scope: Post-P7 deterministic design amendments for the first bug-fix wave. Phase receipts, original coverage check IDs and private baseline archive fingerprints remain historical and unchanged.

revisions.change: A group has one frame and one label when its combined visible-member bounds preserve 24px padding and 8px clearance from nonmembers. Otherwise the existing segmented fallback remains. The label follows the topmost visible member.

cases: one group spanning a root and three branches has one padded frame
a clear cross-branch group merges even when other visible Agents are not members
a combined group frame requires at least 8px clearance from nonmembers
one real four-member Group renders one frame through resizing, card growth and folding

revisions.evidenceScope: The browser regression uses actual Core Group and DashboardProjector data with four nodes and real React/Chrome measurements, resize, growth, folding and group selection. It is a local deterministic fixture with no external model requests. These results do not replace P6/P7 historical verification or claim a new business-model run. Remote CI for the amended PR remains a separate result.
